init.title: Grocy
init.description: Update the connection settings for this Grocy instance.

data_description.grocy_url: The base URL of your Grocy instance (e.g. https://grocy.example.com).
data_description.api_key: The API key from your Grocy profile page.

plan_meal.name: Plan meal
plan_meal.description: Picks a random recipe from Grocy and sends it as a suggestion via a notify service.

entity_id.name: Entity ID
entity_id.description: The sensor entity of the Grocy integration entry to use.

date.name: Date
date.description: The date for which the meal should be planned.

meal_type.name: Meal type
meal_type.description: Only recipes whose name begins with "[meal_type]" will be considered.

calendar.name: Calendar
calendar.description: Calendar used for blacklisting recent meals and adding the accepted recipe.

todo_list.name: Todo list
todo_list.description: Todo list to which the ingredients of the accepted recipe are added.

notify.name: Notify service
notify.description: Notify service (e.g. notify.mobile_app_my_phone) for sending suggestions.

blacklist.name: Blacklist (days)
blacklist.description: Recipes already planned within this many days are excluded from suggestions.

add_meal.name: Add meal
add_meal.description: Pins a specific recipe to a date by adding it directly to the calendar and adding its ingredients to the todo list — no notification or suggestion flow is involved.

entity_id.name: Entity ID
entity_id.description: The sensor entity of the Grocy integration entry to use.

date.name: Date
date.description: The date for which the meal should be planned.

recipe.name: Recipe name
recipe.description: The name of the recipe as it appears in Grocy. Case-insensitive; the "[meal_type]" prefix is optional.

calendar.name: Calendar
calendar.description: The calendar entity to add the meal event to.

todo_list.name: Todo list
todo_list.description: The todo list entity to which the ingredients of the recipe are added.

check_missing_products.name: Check missing products
check_missing_products.description: Checks all products in the Grocy instance against their configured minimum stock amounts and adds missing quantities to a todo list.

entity_id.name: Entity ID
entity_id.description: The sensor entity of the Grocy integration entry to use.

todo_list.name: Todo list
todo_list.description: The todo list entity to which the missing product amounts are added.
